test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eligibility criteria:

The candidate must be B.Sc. graduate with at least 60% marks.

The candidate must have completed M.Sc.

The candidate must be below 28 years of age as on 01-01-2017

Candidate with the prior experience will be given preference.

If the candidate is otherwise eligible, but has no work experience, the case shall be referred to the principal.

If the candidate satisfies all the above criteria, he/she should be selected.

If the information is inadequate, mark the decision as "Information inadequate"

Neeraj is a B.Sc. graduate with 65% marks. He has completed M.Sc. but has no work experience. He is willing to undergo a probation period of one year. Age: 26 years as of 2017.

What decision should be taken?
solution:

 If the candidate is otherwise eligible, but has no work experience, the case shall be referred to the principal.
